text:
maya (People Ops): Folks — need comp-band exception guidance for converting a high-performing contractor (ID 7721) to FTE. Hiring wants base above band + a condensed equity schedule. Can we route?

ryan (Recruiter): Candidate: Priya Nair. On contract since last Oct. Proposed FT: base $125,000, one-time sign-on $7k, equity 0.08% with first vest at 3 months (then quarterly). L5 band cap is $115k and standard equity vests on a 12-mo cliff. Candidate prefers Apr 15 start.

olivia (Hiring Manager): Priya is the only person who can unblock the infra rollout. If we lose her we push sprint deliverables. Recommend approving base bump + accelerated equity. Happy to provide a 5-line business impact note.

samir (Finance): Need run-rate and one-time calculations plus headcount confirmation. Quick calc: base=125000, benefits~=27,500 (22%), one-time=7,000, est_yr_cost~=159,500. We need GL codes for sign-on and equity reserve. If recruiting can reallocate vendor savings, that helps.

diane (Legal): A couple items: 1) contractor IP transfer and final SOW termination must be documented before conversion 2) accelerated vesting needs exec-comp approval and updated equity docs 3) confirm state payroll implications for accelerated vesting.

maya (People Ops): Routing plan: create approval APPR-4912, attach offer, vendor offboard confirmation, finance calc, and hiring note. Ask exec-comp for 72hr review. I'll draft the memo; Ryan paste the offer link.

ryan (Recruiter): Uploaded: /files/PriyaN-offer-draft.pdf and vendor offboard confirmation at https://docs.internal/7721-offboard. Candidate is ok with Apr 15 pending approvals and vendor payroll cutoff Apr 1.

approvals-bot: Approval request created: APPR-4912. Status: pending. Routed to: exec-comp, finance, legal. SLA: 72 hours. Link: https://approvals.internal/APPR-4912

samir (Finance): I'll provisionally approve the one-time payment if recruiting confirms GL strings and the headcount slot. Please set cost center to ENG-RELI-21.

olivia (Hiring Manager): I'll add the business impact note to the approval ticket. I'm available for a quick sync if exec-comp requests it.

maya (People Ops): Final note: if exec-comp approves, we'll set start date "pending vendor offboard and payroll transition" and include conditional accelerated-vesting language in the offer. Please react with :thumbsup: when you've added your internal approval comment.

(olivia) :thumbsup:
(samir) :thumbsup:
(diane) :eyes:
